extension_description.message: Read aloud the current web-page article with one click, using text to speech (TTS). Supports 40+ languages.

options_bt_silence_gap.message: Fix missing first few words of each paragraph when using Bluetooth headset

options_emphasize_italics.message: Emphasize italic text (Google cloud voices only)

cv_subtext_aws.message: Enter AWS credentials to enable Amazon Polly voices

cv_subtext_gcp.message: Enter GCP API key to enable Google Wavenet voices

cv_subtext_ibm.message: Enter IBM API key to enable IBM Watson voices

cv_subtext_azure.message: Enter Azure credentials to enable Microsoft Azure voices

cv_subtext_openai.message: Use OpenAI or an OpenAI-compatible Speech endpoint

options_rate_warning.message: Note: some voices may not work at a high speed.

player_tab_explanation.message: Spotlight Reader uses this tab for audio playback. This tab will automatically close after 5 minutes of no activity.

player_hidethistab_dialog_body.message:
If you hide this tab, Spotlight Reader will play audio inside the current webpage. This means navigating away from the page will cause the speech to stop.

(This setting can be reverted from the extension Options page)

player_permission_dialog_body.message: Allow Spotlight Reader to play audio?

options_word_replacements_help.message: One rule per line: written = spoken. An empty right side skips the word. Matches whole words, ignoring case. /regex/ = replacement for regular expressions ($$1 for groups). The page itself is not changed.

error_no_text.message: Didn't find any text to read, try selecting the text you want to read first

error_upload_pdf.message: Please use the form to upload your PDF file to read aloud

error_ajax_pdf.message: Please save this PDF file to your computer and open it inside this [PDF viewer](open-pdf-viewer) to read aloud

error_file_access.message: You need to grant Spotlight Reader access to local files: open about:addons, select Spotlight Reader, go to the "Permissions and data" tab, then enable "Access local files on your computer"

error_add_permissions.message: You need to grant Spotlight Reader additional [permissions](request-permissions) for this website

error_wavenet_auth_required.message: You need to grant additional [permissions](auth-wavenet) to enable Google Wavenet voices

error_chatgpt.message: Click the speaker icon next to each answer to read it aloud

error_network_unreachable.message: Could not reach {host}. If you're on a corporate network, a proxy or TLS-inspection appliance may be blocking this request.

error_unauthorized.message: {host} rejected the request, please check your API key/credentials

error_rate_limited.message: {host} rate limit reached, please try again later

google_translate_request_permission.message: Spotlight Reader would like to use Google Translate for text-to-speech.

google_translate_keep_page_open.message: Spotlight Reader is using Google Translate for text-to-speech.  Please keep this tab open.

options_auto_select_info.message: When set to "Auto", a voice matching the page language is selected automatically. Priority: ★ favorites → Piper → Google Translate → other voices. Star your preferred voices to control which one is picked per language.

options_voice_note.message: Note: This voice may become unavailable at any time.

options_report_bug.message: Report a bug or request a feature

pt_lang_supertonic.message: 31 languages incl. German, English, Spanish, French, Korean, Portuguese

pt_note_supertonic.message: Install once (~250 MB); then runs fully in-browser via ONNX — no internet, no key. Natural-sounding, 10 voices (5 female + 5 male).

pt_note_piper.message: Per-voice download (~50–200 MB). Install via the "Install Piper voices…" entry in the voice menu.

pt_note_gtranslate.message: No API key required. Sends text to Google servers.

pt_note_gcloud.message: High quality. Enter GCP API key under Custom Voices. Studio voices cost 10× more.

pt_note_polly.message: Enter AWS Access Key ID + Secret under Custom Voices.

pt_note_ibm.message: Enter IBM API key + endpoint URL under Custom Voices.

pt_note_azure.message: Enter Azure region + speech key under Custom Voices.

pt_note_openai.message: Works with OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible TTS endpoint (e.g. self-hosted).
